title: The Gilded Coffin
text: A coffin of beaten gold has been left on the Commons steps, addressed in a fine hand to 'the greatest of the Houses'. It is heavy. It is locked. Something inside it turns over now and then. The Commons will give it to whichever House pays the most iron for the honour.

options.label: Send a sealed bid of iron for the coffin, and claim the honour for your House.

outcomes.text: Your iron is weighed and recorded. The coffin seems to settle a little, as if listening.

options.label: Let the greatest House have it. Whatever turns over inside is theirs to keep.

outcomes.text: You keep your iron and your nerves, and watch to see who carries it home.

together.text: No House bids, and by morning the coffin is gone. That night a golden coffin is seen in the Rift's light, floating towards the Gate.

prize.text: The coffin is yours. Inside lies a fortune in grave-goods beside a corpse in fine clothes. It smiles at the youngest of your House; it has to be buried three times before it stays down.
